_note: Models a run can use, by name. url: an OpenAI-compatible API base. template_kwargs: chat-template variables sent with every request (the thinking switch). A hosted API also needs api_key_env (the environment variable holding its key) and model (its own model id). local: a model served from runtime/ (python pa-to-pa.pyw serve), which listens on url's port: its file, where python pa-to-pa.pyw fetch downloads it from (pinned to one revision) and its size, the context and slots it's served with, and llama-server's placement arguments.

local._placement: every layer on the GPU: llama.cpp's own fitter keeps ~1 GB spare and would leave some in RAM, at a quarter of the speed. ~7.5 GB of an 8 GB GPU.
